source: Live FAC 1.1.5 supplied executable; full retained run in benchmarks/runs/2026-09-29-magnetic-retardation-live
script:
SetAtom('Ne',10,-1,0)
SetBreit(0)
SetSE(0)
SetVP(0)
SetMS(0,0)
SetRadialGrid(2000,-1,-1,-1)
SetTransitionCut(0)
Config('g','1s1')
Config('s','2s1')
Config('p','2p1')
Config('d','3d1')
Config('f','4f1')
Config('q','5g1')
OptimizeRadial(['g'])
Structure('levels.b',['g','s','p','d','f','q'])
MemENTable('levels.b')
PrintTable('levels.b','levels.txt',1)
SetTransitionOptions(2,1)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['p'],-1)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['d'],-2)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['p'],2)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['f'],-3)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['d'],3)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['q'],-4)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['f'],4)
SetTransitionOptions(2,0)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['p'],-1)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['s'],1)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['d'],-2)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['p'],2)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['f'],-3)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['d'],3)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['q'],-4)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['f'],4)
PrintTable('lines.b','lines.txt',1)
scope: E1-E4 long wavelength and finite frequency; M1-M4 finite frequency; nonrelativistic M2-M4 comparison
